# Spiffinity Cleaning & Laundry LLC: full reference
Last updated: 2026-11-01

Spiffinity Cleaning & Laundry LLC is a locally owned cleaning company at 1470 Millbrook Cir, Bradenton, FL 34212. Phone (941) 993-9614. Email cchartier@spiffinitycleaning.com. Hours: Mon–Sat, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM; closed Sunday. Website: https://spiffinitycleaning.com

## Standards
- Eco-friendly, non-toxic, allergen-free products
- Products certified by Green Seal and EPA Safer Choice
- HEPA-filter vacuums and color-coded microfiber to prevent cross-contamination
- Fully bonded and insured
- Trained, background-checked staff authorized to work in the USA
- No independent contractors
- We bring all equipment and supplies
- 64-point quality checklist and the Green Clean Routine on every visit
- 24-hour re-clean guarantee for residential clients

# Services (residential only)

## Residential Cleaning
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/residential-cleaning/
Residential cleaning from Spiffinity is a recurring or one-time house cleaning service for homes, condos and townhomes in Bradenton, Sarasota and Lakewood Ranch. Our insured, background-checked team cleans every room with Green Seal and EPA Safer Choice certified products, HEPA-filter vacuums and a 64-point checklist.
Choose weekly, bi-weekly or monthly visits and we rotate detailed tasks through your schedule, so baseboards, vents and other easy-to-skip spots get attention over time, not only the high-traffic rooms.
Schedule: Weekly, bi-weekly, monthly or one-time
Best for: Busy families and professionals; Seasonal residents and second homes; Condos, townhomes and single-family homes; Pet owners and allergy-prone households
Included:
- Dusting and wiping all reachable surfaces and furniture
- Sanitizing doorknobs, handles and light switches
- HEPA-filter vacuuming of carpets and rugs
- Mopping all hard floors with eco-safe solutions
- Cleaning mirrors and glass
- Kitchen counters, sink, stovetop and appliance exteriors
- Bathroom sinks, tubs, showers, toilets and fixtures
- Emptying trash and replacing liners
- Optional bed-making and linen changes
Add-ons: Inside the oven; Inside the refrigerator; Interior windows and tracks; Cabinet interiors; Laundry, wash & fold; Light organizing
FAQ:
Q: What is included in a standard house cleaning?
A: A standard Spiffinity house cleaning covers kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, living areas, hallways and entryways: dusting, HEPA vacuuming, mopping, sanitizing high-touch surfaces, cleaning mirrors and glass, and taking out the trash. Oven, fridge, cabinet interiors and laundry are available as add-ons.
Q: How much does house cleaning cost in Bradenton?
A: Pricing depends on your home’s size, number of bathrooms, current condition, how often you book and any add-ons. Recurring visits usually cost less per clean than one-time service. Spiffinity gives free, no-obligation quotes; request one online or call (941) 993-9614.
Q: Do I need to be home during the cleaning?
A: No. Many clients leave secure entry instructions or a keyless code. Our fully insured, background-checked team locks up exactly as instructed.
Q: Can I book recurring cleanings?
A: Yes. Choose weekly, bi-weekly or monthly visits. Recurring clients also get a rotating deep-clean system so every part of the home gets detailed attention over time.
Q: What if I’m not fully satisfied?
A: Tell us within 24 hours and we’ll come back to re-clean the area free of charge. That is the Spiffinity Satisfaction Guarantee.
Q: Are your products safe for kids and pets?
A: Yes. We use non-toxic, biodegradable products certified by Green Seal and EPA Safer Choice. If anyone in the home has sensitivities, tell us and we’ll adjust.

## Deep Cleaning
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/deep-cleaning/
Deep cleaning is a top-to-bottom, one-time clean that reaches the areas routine cleaning skips: inside ovens and fridges, baseboards, blinds, window tracks, cabinet fronts and built-up grime in kitchens and bathrooms. Spiffinity deep cleans homes, condos, vacant properties and rentals across Bradenton, Sarasota and Lakewood Ranch.
It’s the right first visit before recurring service, the reset after a busy season, and the standard clean for homes being listed, sold or handed to new occupants.
Schedule: One-time, seasonal, or rotated into a recurring plan
Best for: First visit before recurring service; Homes being listed or recently purchased; Vacant and turnover properties; Seasonal resets and pre-event cleans
Included:
- Detailed dusting of furniture, shelves, fixtures and vents
- Baseboards, doors, door frames and trim
- Blinds, shutters, interior window sills and frames
- Interior oven and refrigerator cleaning
- Kitchen cabinet fronts and detailing
- Countertops, backsplashes and appliance exteriors
- Bathroom grout, tubs, showers, toilets and fixtures
- Vacuuming edges, corners and under accessible furniture
- Detailed couch and upholstery vacuuming
- Deep mopping of all hard floors
Add-ons: Interior glass doors and windows; Cabinet interiors; Light dishwashing and toy pickup; Laundry, wash & fold
FAQ:
Q: What is the difference between deep cleaning and regular cleaning?
A: Regular cleaning keeps a home tidy and maintained. Deep cleaning goes further, tackling built-up grime and hard-to-reach areas such as baseboards, blinds, window sills, cabinet fronts and the inside of ovens and refrigerators.
Q: How long does a deep clean take?
A: Most residential deep cleans take 3–6 hours, depending on the size and condition of the home and the size of the team. We give you an accurate estimate once we know your needs.
Q: Do you deep clean vacant homes?
A: Yes. Vacant-property cleaning is a core part of our deep cleaning service. We prepare homes for listing, showings, sale, rental, new occupants or turnover, including for owners coordinating from out of state.
Q: Can I add deep cleaning tasks to my regular service?
A: Yes. Oven, fridge and other deep-clean tasks can be added to recurring visits. Let us know in advance so we schedule enough time.
Q: Do you move furniture or appliances?
A: We clean around and under light furniture when possible. For safety we do not move heavy items or built-in appliances.

## Move-In & Move-Out Cleaning
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/move-in-move-out-cleaning/
Move-in and move-out cleaning is a detailed, top-to-bottom clean of an empty or nearly empty home, done before new occupants arrive or after the previous ones leave. Spiffinity cleans inside cabinets, drawers, closets and appliances so a home is ready for keys, a final walkthrough or a deposit inspection.
We serve homeowners, renters, landlords, property managers and real estate agents across Bradenton, Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch and the surrounding Suncoast.
Schedule: One-time; book 3–5 days ahead
Best for: Renters handing back keys; Buyers before move-in day; Landlords and property managers between tenants; Real estate agents preparing listings
Included:
- Inside cabinets, drawers and closets
- Kitchen appliances sanitized inside and out
- Tubs, showers, sinks and toilets scrubbed
- Baseboards, doors and trim dusted and wiped
- Walls spot-cleaned, mirrors and fixtures wiped
- All flooring vacuumed and mopped
- HEPA-filter vacuuming to remove allergens
- Light switches, outlets and high-touch surfaces sanitized
Add-ons: Interior windows and tracks; Oven interior; Refrigerator interior; Cabinet interiors
FAQ:
Q: What is included in move-out cleaning?
A: Move-out cleaning includes inside cabinets, drawers and closets, appliances cleaned inside and out, bathrooms scrubbed, baseboards and trim wiped, walls spot-cleaned and all floors vacuumed and mopped. Oven, fridge and cabinet interiors should be requested at booking.
Q: Do you clean empty homes only, or furnished too?
A: Both. Whether a home is fully empty or partly furnished, we adjust the process to deliver a thorough top-to-bottom clean.
Q: How far in advance should I book?
A: We recommend booking at least 3–5 days in advance, especially for weekends and the end-of-month rush. We do our best to accommodate last-minute requests.
Q: Will move-out cleaning help me get my deposit back?
A: A professional move-out clean addresses the areas landlords inspect most, such as appliances, bathrooms, cabinets and floors. We can’t guarantee a landlord’s decision, but if anything is missed, tell us within 24 hours and we’ll make it right.
Q: Are your products safe for new residents?
A: Yes. We only use non-toxic, eco-friendly, allergen-free products, safe for babies, pets and sensitive individuals.

## Apartment & Condo Cleaning
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/apartment-cleaning/
Apartment and condo cleaning is house cleaning sized for smaller, shared-wall homes: studios, one-bedrooms and multi-bedroom units in apartment buildings and condominium towers. Spiffinity uses non-toxic, allergen-free products, which matters in units with shared ventilation, and offers weekly, bi-weekly, monthly or one-time visits.
From downtown Sarasota high-rises to Gulf-front condos on Longboat Key and Anna Maria Island, we work around building rules, parking and elevator access.
Schedule: Weekly, bi-weekly, monthly or one-time
Best for: Renters and condo owners; Seasonal and snowbird residents; Downtown and beachside units; End-of-lease cleans
Included:
- Dusting furniture, décor, fixtures and vents
- Countertops, tables and high-touch surfaces
- HEPA-filter vacuuming of carpets and rugs
- Mopping hard floors with non-toxic products
- Kitchen and bathroom sinks, showers and toilets sanitized
- Mirrors, glass and smudge-prone areas
- Trash removed and liners replaced
Add-ons: Refrigerator interior; Oven interior; Detailed baseboards; Laundry, wash & fold
FAQ:
Q: Do you clean studios, one-bedrooms and larger apartments?
A: Yes. Whether you live in a studio or a multi-bedroom condo, we tailor the cleaning to your space and priorities.
Q: Are your products safe for pets and sensitive residents?
A: Yes. We use non-toxic, eco-certified products that are gentle on allergies and pet-friendly.
Q: Can I book recurring apartment cleanings?
A: Yes. Weekly, bi-weekly and monthly options are available to keep your space consistently fresh.
Q: Do I need to be home while you clean?
A: No. Many clients provide entry instructions or arrange access through the front desk or building manager.
Q: Can you clean my condo before I arrive for the season?
A: Yes. We regularly prepare condos for owners returning for the winter season and close them up after they leave.

## Vacation Rental Cleaning
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/vacation-rental-cleaning/
Vacation rental cleaning is a full turnover clean between guests: bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen and living areas cleaned to hotel standard, beds remade with fresh linens, supplies restocked and the home staged for the next check-in. Spiffinity handles Airbnb and Vrbo turnovers in Bradenton, Anna Maria Island, Longboat Key, Siesta Key and Sarasota.
We follow your property’s checklist, work to tight check-out to check-in windows, and report any damage or low inventory we notice.
Schedule: Per turnover, recurring calendar, or last-minute
Best for: Airbnb and Vrbo hosts; Property managers with multiple units; Beach houses and island condos; Owners who live out of state
Included:
- Stripping and remaking all beds with fresh linens
- Washing, drying and replacing towels (if requested)
- Kitchen and bathrooms cleaned and sanitized
- Dusting and wiping all surfaces and furniture
- HEPA-filter vacuuming of carpets and rugs
- Mopping hard floors, including sand tracked in from the beach
- Restocking supplies (host-provided or ours)
- Trash out and liners replaced
- Guest-ready staging and final touches
- Reporting any damage or low inventory we notice
Add-ons: Restocking with our supplies; Linen and towel laundry; Seasonal deep cleans
FAQ:
Q: What is included in vacation rental cleaning?
A: A full turnover clean of bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen and living areas to hotel standard: beds made with fresh linens, surfaces wiped, floors vacuumed and mopped, trash removed and the home staged for check-in. We also report damage or low inventory.
Q: Can you handle same-day turnovers?
A: Yes. We offer recurring calendar-based service and flexible last-minute cleans for back-to-back bookings. Share your booking calendar and we’ll work to your check-out and check-in times.
Q: Do you provide cleaning supplies?
A: Yes. Our team arrives with professional-grade, eco-friendly products and equipment, so you don’t need to stock cleaning supplies.
Q: Do you restock toilet paper, soap and other essentials?
A: Yes, on request. We restock from your on-site inventory, or provide our own for a small additional charge.
Q: Do you clean rentals on Anna Maria Island and Siesta Key?
A: Yes. We turn over rentals on Anna Maria Island, Holmes Beach, Bradenton Beach, Longboat Key and Siesta Key, along with Bradenton and Sarasota.

## Housekeeping Services
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/housekeeping-services/
Housekeeping is help with the everyday chores that pile up between cleanings: a load of laundry washed and folded, dishes done, beds made and rooms tidied. Spiffinity offers housekeeping as an add-on to any recurring or deep clean, or as a standalone visit, using non-toxic, family-safe products.
Book by task or by room. Busy parents, working professionals and anyone who needs a reset get time back without lowering their standards.
Schedule: Weekly, bi-weekly or as needed
Best for: Busy parents; Working professionals; Seniors who want a helping hand; Recurring cleaning clients
Included:
- Washing and drying a load of laundry during your visit
- Folding and putting away clothes
- Light dish duty and loading or unloading the dishwasher
- Making beds and changing linens
- Tidying and organizing rooms
- Toy pickup and resetting living areas
Add-ons: Combine with house cleaning; Combine with a deep clean; Wash & fold laundry service
FAQ:
Q: What is included in housekeeping services?
A: Housekeeping covers everyday household tasks such as laundry, folding, dishes, bed-making, tidying and organizing, using eco-friendly products. You can customize tasks by room or need.
Q: Can I book housekeeping without a full cleaning?
A: Yes. Many clients add housekeeping to regular cleanings, but you can also book it as a standalone service.
Q: Do I need to provide laundry or dish supplies?
A: We bring our own eco-friendly products. If you prefer a specific detergent or dish soap, let us know and we’ll use yours.
Q: Is your housekeeping team trained and insured?
A: Yes. Every team member is professionally trained, background-checked and fully insured.

## Laundry Services
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/laundry-services/
Spiffinity’s laundry service washes, dries and folds clothes, bed linens and towels for households and vacation rental hosts in Bradenton. We use non-toxic, eco-certified detergent and softener, wash every client’s laundry separately, and offer pickup and drop-off for recurring clients.
It’s the “Laundry” in Spiffinity Cleaning & Laundry, and it pairs naturally with house cleaning and rental turnovers.
Schedule: Weekly, bi-weekly or custom
Best for: Busy households; Airbnb and Vrbo hosts; Seniors and new parents; Recurring cleaning clients
Included:
- Washing and drying clothes, linens, towels and bedding
- Eco-friendly detergent and softener included
- Neatly folded or hung, your preference
- Fresh linen replacement for vacation rentals
- Each client’s laundry washed separately, always
- Pickup and drop-off for recurring clients
- Same-day or next-day service when available
Add-ons: Add to house cleaning; Add to rental turnovers
FAQ:
Q: What types of laundry do you wash?
A: Clothes, towels, bed linens and guest laundry. If you have specialty items, let us know before pickup.
Q: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
A: Yes, for recurring clients in Bradenton. One-time pickups may be available depending on location and schedule.
Q: Do you combine my laundry with other clients’ loads?
A: Never. We wash each client’s laundry separately.
Q: Do you use eco-friendly detergent?
A: Yes. Our detergents are non-toxic, biodegradable and safe for sensitive skin.
Q: Can I schedule recurring laundry service?
A: Yes. Weekly, bi-weekly and custom plans are available for residential and rental clients.

## Post-Construction Cleaning
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/post-construction-cleaning/
Post-construction cleaning removes the dust, debris, adhesive, paint overspray and residue left in a home after building or renovation work, so it is ready to move into. Spiffinity cleans new homes, kitchen and bath remodels, additions and storm-repair projects in Bradenton, Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch and Parrish.
We work to your contractor’s schedule and use HEPA equipment to capture the fine drywall and concrete dust that ordinary vacuums blow back into the air.
Schedule: Per project phase
Best for: Owners of newly built homes; Kitchen, bath and whole-home remodels; Homes repaired after storm damage; Builders handing over a finished home
Included:
- Removal of construction dust and debris
- Removing stickers, residue and paint overspray
- HEPA vacuuming of floors, carpets and hard-to-reach areas
- Mopping and polishing hard floors
- Interior windows, glass, tracks and sills
- Dust removal from walls, doors, trim and vents
- Cabinets, shelving and built-ins, inside and out
- Countertops, backsplashes and fixtures
- Bathrooms and kitchens cleaned top to bottom
- Entryways, garages and lanais swept out
Add-ons: Window track detailing; Light fixture and fan detailing; Move-in clean after furniture arrives
FAQ:
Q: What does post-construction cleaning include?
A: Removing construction dust and debris, vacuuming and mopping floors, cleaning windows and glass, wiping walls, trim and cabinets, cleaning bathrooms and kitchens, removing stickers and residue, and getting the home ready to move into.
Q: Do you clean homes after a renovation?
A: Yes. We clean after kitchen and bath remodels, additions, whole-home renovations and storm-repair work, as well as brand-new homes.
Q: Do you provide rough and final cleaning?
A: Yes. We can schedule a rough clean while the trades finish, a detailed final clean, and a touch-up clean 24–48 hours later before you move in.
Q: Can you work around my contractor’s schedule?
A: Yes. We coordinate with your contractor or builder so the cleaning happens as soon as the work allows.
Q: Why is post-construction cleaning important in Florida?
A: Humidity makes leftover drywall dust a mold and air-quality risk. A thorough HEPA cleanup of surfaces, vents and returns prevents problems that otherwise show up weeks later.

# Service areas

## Bradenton, FL (Manatee County)
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/bradenton/
ZIP codes: 34203, 34205, 34207, 34208, 34209, 34210, 34211, 34212
Neighborhoods: Downtown & the Riverwalk, Village of the Arts, West Bradenton, Palma Sola, Cortez, Bayshore Gardens, River Club, Tara, Heritage Harbour, Braden Woods
Bradenton is Spiffinity’s home base. Our team is based in east Bradenton (34212), so homes from the Riverwalk to Cortez and out to Heritage Harbour get our fastest scheduling. We clean everything from 1920s bungalows in the Village of the Arts to golf-course homes in River Club and new construction off SR 70.
House cleaning: Bradenton homes range from older block-and-stucco ranches in West Bradenton and Bayshore Gardens to golf-course homes in River Club and Tara. Older homes often have original terrazzo or tile that needs pH-neutral products, while waterfront homes near the Manatee River and Palma Sola Bay fight a steady film of humidity and salt on glass and fixtures. Our recurring plans rotate those detailed tasks so they never fall behind.
Moves and deep cleans: Bradenton homes change hands often, and many owners coordinate from out of state. Real estate agents book us for listing cleans, sellers for vacant-home deep cleans, and buyers for a top-to-bottom clean before move-in day.
Renovation cleanup: Infill renovations in established neighborhoods and new subdivisions east of I-75 keep Bradenton busy with construction. We handle rough, final and touch-up cleans for kitchen and bath remodels, additions, new homes and storm repairs, and coordinate with your contractor so the home is ready on schedule.

## Sarasota, FL (Sarasota County)
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/sarasota/
ZIP codes: 34231, 34232, 34233, 34234, 34235, 34236, 34237, 34238, 34239, 34240, 34241, 34243
Neighborhoods: Downtown, Rosemary District, Laurel Park, Burns Court, Southside Village, Gillespie Park, Indian Beach–Sapphire Shores, McClellan Park, St. Armands & Lido Key, Bird Key, Palmer Ranch, Gulf Gate
Spiffinity cleans homes and condos across Sarasota, from downtown high-rises and the Rosemary District to historic Laurel Park cottages, Palmer Ranch family homes and bayfront houses on Bird Key. Our non-toxic Green Clean Routine suits Sarasota’s mix of full-time residents and seasonal owners.
House cleaning: Sarasota housing is unusually varied. Downtown and Rosemary District condo towers come with building rules, freight elevators and concierge check-in, which we coordinate for you. Historic homes in Laurel Park, Burns Court and McClellan Park have original wood floors and older windows that need careful hands, and bayfront homes on Bird Key and Lido Key get salt film on every pane of glass.
Moves and deep cleans: Sarasota runs on a seasonal rhythm: condos readied before owners fly in for winter, homes closed out in spring, and apartments turned over between leases. We deep clean on those dates, including inside cabinets, closets and appliances.
Renovation cleanup: Condo renovations and remodels of older Sarasota homes leave fine dust that settles for days. We provide final and touch-up cleans for renovated condo units, new homes in Palmer Ranch and east Sarasota, and historic-home restorations, working within building rules for debris and elevator use.

## Lakewood Ranch, FL (Manatee & Sarasota counties)
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/lakewood-ranch/
ZIP codes: 34202, 34211, 34212, 34240
Neighborhoods: Summerfield, Riverwalk, Greenbrook, Edgewater, Country Club, Country Club East, Lakewood National, Waterside, Esplanade, Central Park, Polo Run, Mallory Park, Del Webb
Lakewood Ranch is a master-planned community that spans Manatee and Sarasota counties, and it sits minutes from Spiffinity’s east Bradenton base. We clean homes across its villages, from Summerfield and Greenbrook to Lakewood National and Waterside, plus a steady stream of brand-new homes that need post-construction and move-in cleaning.
House cleaning: Lakewood Ranch homes tend to be newer and larger, with high ceilings, big sliders and lanais, and open kitchens with stone counters. That means more glass, more fans and more floor to keep clean. We follow gate and HOA access procedures, clean around pets, and bring HEPA vacuums for the dust that new landscaping and nearby construction push indoors.
Moves and deep cleans: With new villages opening every year, Lakewood Ranch has constant move-ins. We deep clean new and resale homes before the furniture arrives, inside cabinets, closets and appliances, so families start in a home that is clean and not just new.
Renovation cleanup: Lakewood Ranch is regularly ranked among the best-selling master-planned communities in the country, and new villages are still being built. We provide rough, final and touch-up cleans for new homes and remodels, removing drywall dust, stickers and grout haze before closing or move-in.

## Palmetto, FL (Manatee County)
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/palmetto/
ZIP codes: 34221
Neighborhoods: Historic downtown Palmetto, Riviera Dunes, Snead Island, Terra Ceia, Artisan Lakes, US 41 corridor
Palmetto sits across the Manatee River from downtown Bradenton, a short drive over the Green Bridge or the DeSoto Bridge. Spiffinity cleans historic homes near downtown Palmetto, marina condos at Riviera Dunes, waterfront homes on Snead Island and Terra Ceia, and the newer subdivisions to the north.
House cleaning: Palmetto mixes old and new: early-1900s homes near the historic district, marina-front condos at Riviera Dunes, waterfront homes on Snead Island and Terra Ceia, and newer planned communities to the north. Waterfront properties pick up salt and humidity on glass and fixtures; newer homes collect construction dust from ongoing building nearby. We tailor each visit to the home.
Moves and deep cleans: Palmetto’s newer neighborhoods to the north bring a steady flow of move-ins, while waterfront homes and Riviera Dunes condos change hands between seasonal owners. We deep clean before listings, after closings and between tenants.
Renovation cleanup: New subdivisions north of downtown and renovations of Palmetto’s older homes both need professional cleanup before anyone moves in. We provide rough, final and touch-up cleans for new homes, remodels and additions.

## Ellenton, FL (Manatee County)
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/ellenton/
ZIP codes: 34222
Neighborhoods: Colony Cove, Areas along US 301, Neighborhoods near the Manatee River, Communities near I-75 Exit 224, Gamble Plantation area
Ellenton is a community on the north bank of the Manatee River, between Palmetto and Parrish, with easy I-75 access at Exit 224. Spiffinity cleans homes in Ellenton’s established neighborhoods and 55+ communities, and new homes going up toward Parrish.
House cleaning: Many Ellenton residents live in 55+ and manufactured-home communities such as Colony Cove, where a consistent, trusted team matters as much as the clean itself. We send the same insured, background-checked cleaners each visit, use non-toxic products that are easy on sensitive lungs, and can add housekeeping help like laundry and bed changes.
Moves and deep cleans: Whether you’re downsizing into a 55+ community or settling into a new build toward Parrish, we deep clean both ends of the move and can add laundry and bed-making so the first night in the new home feels settled.
Renovation cleanup: New homes between Ellenton and Parrish, plus renovations of older homes near the river, keep construction steady. We provide rough, final and touch-up cleans that remove fine dust and debris before move-in.

## Parrish, FL (Manatee County)
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/parrish/
ZIP codes: 34219
Neighborhoods: North River Ranch, Silverleaf, Harrison Ranch, Twin Rivers, River Wilderness, Forest Creek
Parrish is one of the fastest-growing parts of Manatee County, with new master-planned communities spreading out from US 301 and Fort Hamer Road. Spiffinity helps Parrish families with move-in cleans for brand-new homes, recurring house cleaning once they settle in, and post-construction cleaning when the builder hands over the keys.
House cleaning: Most Parrish homes are new or nearly new, and that brings its own cleaning needs: builder dust in cabinets and vents, grout haze on new tile, and window stickers that never quite came off. Once settled, busy Parrish families with kids and pets lean on bi-weekly cleaning to keep up. Our non-toxic products are safe around both.
Moves and deep cleans: Most Parrish moves are into brand-new homes, and new isn’t the same as clean. We remove builder dust from inside cabinets, closets and vents, polish off grout haze and window stickers, and wipe every surface before the moving truck arrives.
Renovation cleanup: Parrish has some of the most active home building in the county. We provide rough, final and touch-up cleans for new homes and the remodels that follow, and a detailed clean for new owners before the moving truck arrives.

## Anna Maria Island, FL (Manatee County)
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/anna-maria-island/
ZIP codes: 34216, 34217
Neighborhoods: Anna Maria, Holmes Beach, Bradenton Beach, Pine Avenue, Bridge Street, Coquina Beach area
Anna Maria Island is a seven-mile barrier island with three cities, Anna Maria, Holmes Beach and Bradenton Beach, reached from Bradenton by the Manatee Avenue and Cortez Road bridges. Spiffinity provides vacation rental turnovers, beach-house cleaning, laundry and linens, and post-construction cleaning for the many island homes rebuilt after the 2024 hurricane season.
House cleaning: A large share of Anna Maria Island homes are vacation rentals, so cleaning runs on a check-out, check-in clock. We strip and remake beds, wash linens, restock supplies and sweep out the sand that comes in on every pair of flip-flops. For owner-occupied beach homes we offer recurring cleaning with extra attention to salt-coated glass and outdoor showers.
Moves and deep cleans: Island homes change guests and owners constantly. Besides weekly turnovers, owners book us for a deep clean at the start of the season, after a long-term tenant leaves, or before listing a beach house for sale.
Renovation cleanup: Hurricanes Helene and Milton in 2024 brought storm surge to the island, and many homes have since been repaired, raised or rebuilt. We clean after flood-repair work, renovations and new construction, removing the drywall and concrete dust that follows a rebuild.

## Longboat Key, FL (Manatee & Sarasota counties)
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/longboat-key/
ZIP codes: 34228
Neighborhoods: Longbeach Village, Bay Isles, Country Club Shores, Gulf of Mexico Drive condos, Longboat Key Club area
Longboat Key is a barrier island that straddles Manatee and Sarasota counties, between Anna Maria Island and Lido Key. Spiffinity cleans Gulf-front condos, seasonal homes and luxury residences along Gulf of Mexico Drive, from Longbeach Village at the north end to Bay Isles and the communities near St. Armands at the south.
House cleaning: Many Longboat Key homeowners are seasonal. We open homes before owners arrive, keep them up during the season, and close them out with a detailed clean when they leave. High-end finishes like marble, natural stone and large panes of Gulf-facing glass get the right products and careful handling.
Moves and deep cleans: For seasonal owners on Longboat Key, the two most important cleans of the year are the opening clean before you arrive and the close-out clean when you leave. We also deep clean condos before listing and after long-term rentals.
Renovation cleanup: Condo renovations, unit remodels and storm repairs after the 2024 hurricane season are common on Longboat Key. We clean renovated units and homes to a move-in standard while following association rules on work hours and elevator use.

## Siesta Key, FL (Sarasota County)
URL: https://spiffinitycleaning.com/siesta-key/
ZIP codes: 34242
Neighborhoods: Siesta Key Village, Crescent Beach, Turtle Beach, Point O’ Rocks, Midnight Pass Road condos, North Siesta
Siesta Key is the Sarasota barrier island known for its powder-fine quartz sand at Siesta Beach. Spiffinity cleans vacation rentals, condos and beach homes from Siesta Key Village to Crescent Beach and Turtle Beach, and handles post-construction cleaning for properties repaired after Hurricane Milton made landfall on the key in October 2024.
House cleaning: Siesta Key’s fine quartz sand gets into everything: grout lines, slider tracks, rugs and the corners of every closet. Our turnover and recurring cleans include detailed floor and track cleaning, HEPA vacuuming of rugs and upholstery, and salt-film removal on Gulf-facing glass. We clean rentals on your booking calendar and condos for seasonal owners.
Moves and deep cleans: Between the rental market and seasonal owners, Siesta Key condos turn over often. We deep clean units at the start of the season, after long-term guests and before listings, with extra time for sand in tracks, grout and closets.
Renovation cleanup: Hurricane Milton came ashore on Siesta Key in October 2024, and the island has seen extensive repairs and rebuilding since. We provide post-construction cleaning for repaired and renovated homes, condos and rentals so they’re ready for guests again.

# General FAQ
Q: What cleaning services does Spiffinity offer?
A: Spiffinity Cleaning & Laundry LLC cleans homes: recurring house cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in and move-out cleaning, post-construction and renovation cleaning, apartment and condo cleaning, vacation rental turnovers, housekeeping and laundry.
Q: Do you clean businesses?
A: No. Spiffinity is a residential cleaning company. We clean houses, condos, apartments and vacation rentals only.
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are based in Bradenton, Florida and serve Bradenton, Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch, Palmetto, Ellenton, Parrish, Anna Maria Island, Longboat Key and Siesta Key. Nearby and not sure? Call (941) 993-9614.
Q: Are your products safe for kids and pets?
A: Yes. We use non-toxic, allergen-free products certified by Green Seal and EPA Safer Choice, with HEPA-filter vacuums and color-coded microfiber cloths that prevent cross-contamination.
Q: Are your cleaners insured and background-checked?
A: Yes. Spiffinity is fully bonded and insured. Every cleaner is a trained, background-checked employee authorized to work in the USA. We do not use independent contractors.
Q: How much does house cleaning cost?
A: It depends on your home’s size and condition, the service, how often you book and any add-ons. Recurring visits cost less per clean than one-time service. Quotes are free; request one online or call (941) 993-9614.
Q: Do I need to be home?
A: No. Many clients leave entry instructions or a keyless code, and we lock up exactly as asked.
Q: Do I need to provide supplies?
A: No. Our team brings every product and piece of equipment.
Q: What if something was missed?
A: Tell us within 24 hours and we come back to re-clean that area free. That’s the Spiffinity Satisfaction Guarantee.
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. We’re closed on Sunday.
